verdict.rationale: Twilio documents Video Insights, a free tool for video performance and data analysis, and a Network Quality API for monitoring participant network quality. Together these show its own dashboard and API surfaces for call-quality debugging, but the evidence never names the specific per-session metrics. missing for 10: explicit documentation of packet loss, jitter, and bitrate metrics; per-session/per-room drill-down detail in Video Insights; API access to historical session metrics; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, per-session quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter, and bitrate are available through a dashboard or API for debugging calls

citations.quote: Optimize your application proactively with Video Insights, a free tool for advanced video performance and data analysis
Monitor participant network quality with the Network Quality API
